authorization_gate.rule: Preparation of this freeze and runner does not authorize execution. Any implementation must fail before the first S3 API call unless all authorization gates are explicitly enabled in a later immutable amendment.

official_source.reason_explorer_blocks_excluded: Official Explorer semantic probe already completed 301/301 blocks with zero oracle key paths and zero oracle type labels; paying to obtain equivalent explorer-block bytes is not justified for P0E.

deterministic_key_resolution.step_1: Requester-pays ListObjectsV2 on replica_cmds/ with delimiter '/' and MaxKeys<=1000 to enumerate canonical start_time common prefixes. If listing is truncated, fail closed rather than paginate adaptively.
deterministic_key_resolution.step_2: For every returned start_time prefix, issue a requester-pays existence/list probe for the exact date component 20240901. Exactly one start_time prefix must expose target-date objects; zero => TECHNICAL_BLOCKED_TARGET_DATE_NOT_FOUND; more than one => TECHNICAL_BLOCKED_AMBIGUOUS_START_TIME_PREFIX.
deterministic_key_resolution.step_3: Under the unique target-date prefix, ListObjectsV2 with prefix equal to the decimal center_height token. Exactly one object whose final path component begins with center_height and differs only by a stable suffix/extension may resolve the key template; otherwise fail closed.
deterministic_key_resolution.step_4: Derive keys for all 301 frozen heights by substituting only the decimal height token while preserving the resolved prefix and suffix. No date, height, radius or object-selection adaptation after inspecting bytes.

pre_download_cost_caps.rule: HEAD every frozen object before GET. If any object is missing/ambiguous or any byte/request cap would be exceeded, stop before object-body downloads and classify TECHNICAL_BLOCKED_COST_OR_COMPLETENESS_CAP.

allowed_decoders_frozen_pre_execution: LZ4 frame then UTF-8 JSON/JSON Lines

schema_extraction_policy.hip3_guard: Any perpDeploy/setOracle or HIP-3 deployer-oracle record is explicitly insufficient for native BTC/ETH validator-oracle reconstruction.

decision_rule.PASS_NATIVE_ORACLE_SCHEMA_CANDIDATE: All 301 frozen replica_cmds objects are uniquely resolved, downloaded within the pre-frozen caps, parsed, and at least one non-HIP-3 native-oracle-related key path or action/type label is visible. This only permits a separately frozen P1 deterministic reconstruction audit; it does not reopen economic outcomes.
decision_rule.FAIL_NO_NATIVE_ORACLE_SCHEMA_VISIBLE: All 301 frozen replica_cmds objects are uniquely resolved, downloaded and parsed within caps, but no non-HIP-3 native-oracle-related schema path/action/type label is visible.
decision_rule.TECHNICAL_BLOCKED_COST_OR_COMPLETENESS_C: Object/key resolution, completeness, decoder support, request caps or byte caps prevent complete adjudication.
decision_rule.BLOCKED_NO_AUTHORIZATION: Requester-pays/AWS credential execution was not explicitly authorized before the first S3 request.
